description: Student housing near a university from Student.com (US and Canada): property name, type (PBSA = purpose-built student accommodation, Apartment...), monthly price from/to as listed, rating, distance from the campus in miles, coordinates and listing URL, nearest first, plus the number of properties Student.com maps around that campus. Input = the slugs in Student.com's university URL. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
